Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, portables, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessments covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Sections 5, Facility Condition Assessments & Site Master Plans).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology; includes capacity utilization data by site and classroom; links enrollment projections to specific facility actions including new construction and reconfiguration; proposes adaptive uses of space (Section 2.3 Enrollment Changes, Section 4 Program Costs).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational specifications for multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, STEAM, maker spaces, and collaborative learning; facility projects directly respond to educational goals with comprehensive analysis (Section 3 Program Vision & Standards).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Positions outdoor greening and climate-adapted design as central; provides districtwide data on green spaces, shade coverage, and stormwater management; details strategies for campus greening including tree cover, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, and frames greening as climate resilience (Sections 3.2 Outdoor Learning, Site Elements).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate change impacts and includes some sustainable strategies such as solar-ready buildings and drought-tolerant landscaping; however, lacks comprehensive districtwide climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies for multiple climate impacts (Section 2.2 Sustainable Strategies).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as solar panels, LED lighting, HVAC upgrades; discusses energy resilience goals; references Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals; lacks comprehensive energy resilience strategies like microgrids or detailed electrification plans (Section 2.2 Sustainable Strategies).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates by project and scope; includes prioritization framework based on safety, modernization, and program alignment; outlines multiple funding strategies including bonds and state programs; considers long-term financial sustainability (Section 4 Program Costs, Section 6 Appendix).
